$comment: Machine-readable mandate for the pro-investor-01 UAT persona. Fictional; notional capital. Read by uat/harness/paperbroker.py, which enforces every constraint in `constraints` as a hard reject rather than a warning.

execution.$comment: Orders are decided on data through session D-1 close and filled at session D open. See uat/harness/paperbroker.py for why this is the only fill rule that is defensible without lookahead.
execution.$comment_commission: Robinhood-style zero commission. Regulatory fees are modelled on sells only.

feedback_focus: partial totals labelled at the point of display

severity_scale.blocker: Cannot complete a core task, or the number shown is wrong.
severity_scale.major: Task completable but the workaround is costly or the output is misleading.
severity_scale.minor: Noticeable friction with an obvious workaround.

finding_kinds.friction: The application is right but costly to use.
finding_kinds.gap: The application is missing something the mandate needs.
